steps.imagePrompt: Flat vector illustration, 16:9 ratio, for an online C++ course. On an elevated rocky observation ridge overlooking a massive Martian rift canyon at twilight. The mascot has NO legs, NO feet, NO body, NO black bounding box, NO arms. Distant Martian canyon walls in desaturated warm greys, strictly no red.
